capabilities: Standardize block spacing across Live Preview, Reading view and PDF export
Resize images by dragging corners and write Obsidian's native size syntax
Apply text color, background highlight and underline as merged HTML spans
Drag blocks, headings and list items to move them on desktop and mobile
Read notes aloud with sentence highlighting, speed control and resume position
disambiguation: Not an editor replacement; it registers no keyboard handlers and leaves Enter, Tab and Backspace entirely to Obsidian's native editing.
extras: The interface is primarily Chinese. The optional Baidu read-aloud source is not an official Baidu service and sends each read sentence to fanyi.baidu.com; system-voice reading is offline. The plugin saves local backups before formatting runs and warns against running it alongside other drag-and-drop plugins such as Dragger or paragraph-spacing CSS snippets.
problem: Obsidian's default block spacing varies with themes and stacks theme margins, and there are no built-in drag-to-resize images, text color/highlight/underline tools, or read-aloud playback.

relations.evidence: a card with it follows the pointer, and it flashes where it lands, as in wolai
Keep Excalidraw installed if you use drawings; this plugin does not replace it.

summary: Styling toolkit that standardizes paragraph, quote, table and image spacing, resizes images by dragging, adds text color, highlight and underline, and reads notes aloud.
